meta.title: Rent a Top Tech SaaS Company
meta.description: Rentatoptech, S.L. is a Spanish software studio building SaaS products, from vacation rental tools to fintech invoicing.

hero.title: A software studio building SaaS products
hero.subtitle: We design, build and operate software products end to end — from vacation rental management to fintech invoicing. Based in Madrid, building for the world.

about.title: About Rentatoptech
about.body: Rentatoptech, S.L. is a software company incorporated in Spain. We build and operate our own SaaS products rather than client work — each one solves a real, specific problem we understand deeply, from the plumbing to the pricing page. Our current focus sits mostly in the vacation rental space, plus a fintech product for automated invoicing.

projects.title: Our projects
projects.subtitle: Live products, built and operated by our team.

items.amplistay: Automated direct bookings, late check-outs and stay extensions for vacation rental hosts — synced with iCal, paid via Stripe.
items.rentalotop: Marketplace of verified service providers for vacation rentals: cleaning, linen, laundry, check-in and maintenance, with free quotes.
items.rentalSites: Custom booking websites for vacation rental and rural accommodation businesses.
items.factulink: Automated Stripe-to-Holded invoicing bridge, built for Spanish tax compliance.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The data controller for this website is Rentatoptech, S.L., with the details listed in our Legal Notice.

data.title: 2. What data we collect
data.body: This website does not use analytics, tracking cookies, or forms that collect personal data. If you contact us by email or WhatsApp, we process the personal data you voluntarily provide (name, contact details, and the content of your message) solely to respond to your enquiry.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis
purpose.body: We process this data based on your consent, given by contacting us, for the sole purpose of answering your message. We do not use it for any other purpose, and we do not share it with third parties except where required by law.

retention.title: 4. Retention
retention.body: We keep correspondence only for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and any follow-up, after which it is deleted.
